summary: Verified corner-peel flip-hint on /properties. Mobile (touch, hover:none): flip-hint present and visible (display:block) only on first card; absent from cards 2 and 3. After tapping first card, is-flipped class added and flip-hint removed from DOM. Desktop: flip-hint element rendered in DOM but computed display:none (CSS gated to @media (hover:none)) — not visible. No console errors in either context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flip-hint feature confirmed working. Mobile: 1 hint on first card only (visible); Desktop: hint hidden via CSS. After flip on mobile the hint disappears from DOM. No console errors.
